about: In 1999, Almimari established an agreement with Theysohn Extrusion Technik (Germany), Greiner Extrusion (Austria) and Foris (Plustec-Germany), who are leaders in UPVC and related technologies to develop a profile system with German standards and specifications suitable for harsh weather conditions extruded in the United Arab Emirates.
Increasing energy, prices and growing environmental consciousness lead to the expectation that the trend of using UPVC windows and doors will continue worldwide on a long term basis.
